== Course of events ==

After Dorothy failed to summon the Winged Monkeys to carry her across the desert back to Kansas, and after the four companions gathered in the Throne Room where the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Lion each spoke of their contentment with what they had gained in Oz, the Scarecrow was made ruler of the Emerald City. The people of the Emerald City took pride in being governed by a stuffed man, accepting the Scarecrow as their new sovereign even as Dorothy, the Tin Woodman, and the Lion prepared to accompany her homeward.

Once established as ruler, the Scarecrow turned his attention to Dorothy's journey, deciding that she must travel south to Glinda's castle despite the warnings of wild beasts and hostile Quadlings said to lie along that road.
